completeness.why: finishLinkingAccount takes the whole upgrade/insert/payee/sync/sync-event sequence and GoCardless only passes its own data, but the diff never routes linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount or linkEnableBankingAccount through it; they keep their full local copies.

interface.why: The helper parameterises the real variations (create fields for mask/official_name, optional fileId for Pluggy, tables for Akahu) without speculative options, though only one caller exercises them so the preserved inconsistencies are not yet made explicit at the other sites.

disguised_duplication.where: The new finishLinkingAccount body is a plain copy of the sequence still present verbatim in the four unconverted link functions in server/accounts/app.ts; the duplication is left in the open (incomplete refactor), not disguised.
